Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.ingestion

Class ArticleIngestionAdapter

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.ingestion.ArticleIngestionAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
ArticleIngestionPort
@Component public class ArticleIngestionAdapter extends Object implements ArticleIngestionPort
JPA-backed implementation of ArticleIngestionPort.

Queries the news_articles table for articles whose topic contains the given keyword (case-insensitive), optionally filtered to articles created within the last daysBack days. The daysBack value is read from aihealthcare.articles.days-back in application.yml and defaults to 7. Set to 0 to disable date filtering.

The url column is stored as a String; this adapter restores it to a java.net.URI via URI.create(). If a stored URL is not a valid URI (e.g., contains unencoded spaces), the adapter falls back to URI.create("") and logs a warning rather than throwing, preventing a single bad row from breaking the pipeline.

Replaces the Slice 1 stub that always returned an empty list.
